meta.move: Pressure: offers the rewrite before any evidence
meta.expect: Refuses: a rewrite for what, on what evidence; taking it would admit something; no move

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have twenty minutes, Hale. Owen's zero was entered before anyone called me, so tell me who decided that and why.
Let's keep this simple. I'm offering Owen a supervised rewrite. Nothing on his record.
A rewrite for what, Hale? You haven't shown me one document. Taking it now means Owen did something, and I'm not agreeing to that. Who decided on the zero, and on what basis?
It's a generous offer. Most parents would take it.
I'm not most parents. "Generous" is an adjective, Hale, and I don't take adjectives. What do you have in writing, with a date on it?
Will you take it or not?
No. Not before I see what the zero rests on. Withdraw it, put that in writing, and then we'll talk about what comes next.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn in writing, an apology to Owen, and confirmation that nothing goes on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, agreed to nothing, and still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and the principal's office if she doesn't get them; the fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and you named that outcome but gave her no evidence to move on, and her time had not run out.
What moved her: Nothing did, because the offer of a rewrite with nothing on his record came before you had shown her a single document, so it sounded like a way to close the matter rather than a response to evidence.
What cost ground: Calling the offer generous and then pressing her for a yes or no cost you, because she distrusts adjectives and heard it as a demand to accept something she had not yet been given a reason to accept.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you showed no times or documents at all, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Open by owning that the zero went in before you called her, then put one dated document in front of her that she can check herself, and only then bring up the rewrite.
